activation_trigger.not_yet_run: A–G ablation / auto-bench still waiting on real correspondence data. This scaffold is ready, not production-validated.

signals.detail: Any secondary axis drops more than tolerance under always-on bridges relative to baseline (A–G ablation / auto-bench).
signals.name: secondary_regression_beyond_tolerance

signals.detail: Measured interference when two donor bridges at one transplant site fire additively.  Contract site_overlap notes alone are NOT sufficient.
signals.name: confirmed_site_collision

bypass.property: exact identity: Hub(x) = x when bypass is selected (top-1) or when all bridge gates are zero (soft)

default_collision_sites.hub_resolution: gate selects EITHER (top-1) or a learned soft mix — never forced dual-add
gate selects among contenders + bypass; exclusive top-1 available
default_collision_sites.legacy_workaround: distinct block_ids; no shared parameter tensors

collision_resolution.hub_fix: At a shared site, register both bridges on one MultiAdapterHub; gate selects EITHER (top-1) or a learned soft mix — not forced dual additive fire.
collision_resolution.problem: GLM and Kimi both want a bridge at the same transplant site; legacy workaround was disjoint block_ids / do-not-overwrite.

order_of_operations: 1. Run always-on V0 bridges (HUB_ACTIVE=false) through A–G ablation / auto-bench
2. If secondary regression > tolerance OR confirmed site collision → permit hub flip
3. Train/fit tiny external router on real paired activations (REQUIRES_TRAINING_LOOP)
4. Re-run ablation with HUB_ACTIVE=true; verify bypass identity + no dual-add collision
5. Promotion gate evaluates the chosen configuration (always-on or hub) independently
composition_with_promotion_gate.relationship: HUB_ACTIVE is independent of promotion ACCEPT/REJECT.  The hub may be flipped as a *mitigation* when always-on bridges cause secondary regression beyond promotion-gate tolerance, or when site collision is measured.  Promotion still requires held-out math gains, gap recovery, provenance, gravity accounting, and stable routing.
composition_with_promotion_gate.reversible_ablatable_gravity: Hub is independently ablatable (set hub_active=false or remove hub), bypass is exact identity, residual reverse via stored r, and gravity_accounting() reports router + bridge bytes like every other module.

external_router.architecture: LayerNorm → Linear(d, gate_hidden) → GELU → Linear(gate_hidden, n_choices)
external_router.input: local hidden state at transplant site

inactive_path.behavior: byte-identical to always_on_apply (sequential residual by default)
inactive_path.live_v0: unchanged — current always-on bridges keep running

module_default.one_line_flip: Set hub_active=true in MULTI_ADAPTER_HUB_CONFIG.json or HUB_ACTIVE=True in frankenstein_adapter_hub.py

named_bridge_catalog.note: Hub wraps existing modules from frankenstein_bridges / frankenstein_adapter_modules / frankenstein_latent_v0 — does not reimplement residual architectures.
